question: The median of the data 9, 12, 11, 8, 16, 18, 10, 14, 15, 13, 17, 20, 2, 24 is x . If 2 and 8 are replaced by 21 and 18 in this data, respectively, then the median of the data so obtained is y. What is the value of (3x - y)?
solution:
**Given:**

Median of the data 9, 12, 11, 8, 16, 18, 10, 14, 15, 13, 17, 20, 2, 24.

**Concept Used:**

If the number of observations is even, then the median is the simple average of the middle two terms.

**Calculation:**

Given data= 9, 12, 11, 8, 16, 18, 10, 14, 15, 13, 17, 20, 2, 24
